name: zeroize
mechanism: 逐字节write_volatile(0)禁死存储消除+写后compiler_fence(SeqCst)防重排下沉;纯Rust无FFI

name: zeroize误用模式(Vec realloc/panic=abort)
mechanism: Vec扩容realloc旧缓冲不清零(docs.rs明文告诫,须with_capacity预分配);panic=abort不走unwind致Drop清零失效,防线移交转储配置

name: secrecy
mechanism: SecretBox的Debug固定输出[REDACTED];故意不实现Display使{}打印编译错,逼出expose_secret()显式暴露点;Drop经zeroize清零

name: Windows凭据管理器+DPAPI
mechanism: CredWrite/CredRead(advapi32)读写凭据条目;底层DPAPI以当前用户登录凭据派生密钥链(口令解锁包裹密钥再包内容);CryptProtectData可独立加密文件blob(CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN适配服务会话)

name: VirtualLock与工作集限制
mechanism: POSIX mlock/Windows VirtualLock钉页防换页;Windows受进程工作集上下限约束(SetProcessWorkingSetSize)超限失败;防落盘换页但防不了副本与转储,收益面窄

name: memsec
mechanism: 页面对齐分配(Unix memalign/Windows VirtualAlloc页粒度)+mlock/mprotect封装(Windows走VirtualLock/VirtualProtect)+guard page越界哨兵

name: 子进程env泄漏面与白名单
mechanism: 子进程默认继承父全量环境块;泄漏面=同用户进程可读环境块(默认ACL下)+/proc/environ+传更深子进程(GIT_*注入教训);防法env_clear起步+显式envs白名单+secret走stdin/ACL文件不走env
license: 机制来自系统文档与Git生态实践(无单一license主体)

name: WER LocalDumps/MiniDumpWriteDump
mechanism: HKLM...Windows Error Reporting\LocalDumps(可按exe子键)DumpType=1小转储/2=全内存含堆(含secret堆);默认%LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps;MiniDumpCallback可逐区过滤(进阶)

name: GitHub Actions日志掩码语义
mechanism: 注册secret(repo/env/org+::add-mask::)在日志命中即整体替换定长***不泄漏长度;局限=base64/变换不匹配/逐字符跨行绕过/短值不可靠;定位防意外打印非防对抗;secret scanning是另一条线

name: keyring v3
mechanism: v3重构为平台store:windows-native-keyring-store(1.1.0,Vista+,多service命名格式模拟)+apple-native+secret-service系backend;统一Entry::new(service,user) set/get/delete

name: windows-rs直调CredWriteW
mechanism: Windows.Win32.Security.Credentials模块直调Win32凭据API,换取CRED_PERSIST档位与标志位细粒度控制;作为keyring不达需求时的降级实现

name: macOS Keychain/Linux secret-service(对照)
mechanism: Keychain(Security.framework用户登录解锁)与secret-service(DBus org.freedesktop.secrets需DBus会话,headless/CI常缺失触发降级路径)

name: 日志脱敏钩子(tracing层)
mechanism: 字段值用secrecy封装(Debug即[REDACTED])+tracing-subscriber格式化层自定义Visit按字段名(token/password/key/secret族)二次兜底替换

name: GitHub secret scanning(push protection)
mechanism: 提交前模式匹配拦截+alert不回显完整值+secret_scanning.yml旁路配置;与日志掩码并行的另一条线

name: shrouded
mechanism: mlock/VirtualLock锁RAM+guard page+mprotect再锁+drop清零的一体化secret类型(2026-03新crate,自带与memsec/secstr对照表);太新成熟度未验证
